inHouse.title: The software our own agents run on
inHouse.intro: We run our own agents on these products every day. They show the engineering behind client work; your IT team can inspect each one.

cases.summary: Buyers arrived with a question, not a product, and a contact form left them to work it out alone.
cases.problem: Workstation sells AI workstations, GPU servers and clusters. These are big purchases, and most buyers start with a question rather than a product: "what do I need to run this model?" A brochure site and a contact form make the buyer do the hard part.
cases.built: A new website and an AI shop with an AI Sales Agent. The agent asks what the buyer wants to run, their budget and where it should be delivered, then builds the basket and hands a priced request to the sales team. People at Workstation check and send every quote.

results.label: the AI Sales Agent answers buyers at any hour

cases.duration: Results within a couple of months of launch
cases.disclosure: Workstation and TenthMatrix are both brands of Workstation Solutions Ltd, so this is our own work, not an outside client. You can visit both sites and check what we say.
technical: AI Sales Agent with a person approving every quote
Content, catalogue and leads held in OpsAPI
Releases promoted int → test → acc → prod by Ring Promoter, gated on health checks
Static main site served through the Proxy10x gateway and CDN
Built with AI pair coding; a person reviewed and merged every change

cases.summary: Mid-market firms in regulated industries wanted AI assistants, but their data could not leave their own systems.
cases.problem: Cogno AI wanted a platform that brings enterprise-grade AI to mid-market businesses, including clients in healthcare, legal and financial services whose data has to stay under their control.
cases.built: We designed and developed their flagship platform: several AI agents working together, document processing, assistants trained on each client's own data, workflows that connect to existing CRM, ERP and email tools, and a no-code builder so non-technical teams can set up their own AI workflows.

results.label: or private cloud, so data stays with the client

quote.text: TenthMatrix designed and developed our flagship AI platform that brings enterprise-grade artificial intelligence to mid-market businesses.

technical: Multi-agent orchestration with a knowledge graph
Fine-tuned language models trained on client-specific data
Integrations with CRM, ERP and communication tools
Runs on-premise or in a private cloud

cases.summary: Legal professionals spent too long searching vast amounts of legal data for what they needed.
cases.problem: LexisNexis manages vast amounts of legal, regulatory and business information, and needed AI that could help legal professionals find and analyse it faster.
cases.built: AI research assistants that read and analyse legal documents, plus predictive analytics for case outcomes, built on GPT-4 and Claude models.

quote.text: The integration of GPT-4 and Claude models has revolutionized how legal professionals interact with our platform, reducing research time by 65% while improving accuracy and relevance.
quote.by: Michael Stevens, Chief Technology Officer, LexisNexis Legal Solutions

technical: Natural-language processing for legal document analysis

cases.summary: Releases across 50+ global projects were slow and took too much hands-on work.
cases.problem: HCL runs DevOps for more than 50 global projects for enterprise clients, and needed releases to be faster and systems to stay up.
cases.built: Automated deployment and monitoring across their projects, with alerts and predictions that flag problems before they reach users.

quote.text: The AI-powered automation reduced our deployment time by 70% and improved system reliability to 99.99% uptime.
quote.by: Rajesh Kumar, VP of Engineering, HCL Technologies

cases.summary: A bank needed faster incident response and audit-ready security without slowing change down.
cases.problem: In banking, security and reliability come first, but digital change still has to move quickly.
cases.built: Monitoring and security tooling with real-time alerts and automated incident response.

quote.text: The platform's real-time alerting and automated incident response reduced our MTTR by 80%, ensuring uninterrupted service for our millions of customers globally.
quote.by: James Patterson, Head of Infrastructure, Barclays

track.summary: Automated catalogue production for a leading academic publisher, linked to InDesign and their content systems, cutting publishing time from weeks to days.
Combined price lists from many furniture manufacturers into one database, then published formatted, illustrated price lists in minutes.
One product database that publishes both the 108-page printed catalogue and the website, so new products, pictures and technical data go live with ease.
Member data and publishing for a Brussels business association: professional directories produced from one database.
A complex 150-page catalogue produced in about a week instead of three to four, without losing design quality.
Website management and customer portal systems that help a local authority deliver better online services to residents.
Property data and catalogue publishing across global markets, keeping a luxury brand consistent.
Product information for a design brand published beautifully in print and online from one source.
Certification and test data organised in one system, with professional compliance reports produced from it.
Thousands of business listings managed in one database and published as print directories on tight deadlines.
